releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.18.1 — the small update with the big timeline fix.

THE TIMELINE IS HONEST NOW
• When you scrub, the bar stays exactly where your finger left it until the player's own playhead confirms the seek — it never snaps back to the old position while the buffer refills. That snap-back was the "not synced with the music" you saw.
• The bar follows the 50fps playback clock directly now — no animation stutter, motion continuous at display rate, time labels ticking exactly with the audio.

ALL LINES NORMAL
• Every slider in the app is a plain, standard line by default (seek bar, volume, equalizer). The liquid-wave decoration is off for everyone out of the box; it stays available in Settings for anyone who wants it back.

EVERY LINE ANSWERS YOUR FINGER
• Seek bar, volume line and equalizer faders all tick with the same iPhone-style haptics: grab, every notch crossing, the 0 dB center snap, and release. The volume line had no haptics at all before.

DOWNLOADS THAT ANSWER THE TAP
• The player's Download button acknowledges instantly — "Starting…" right on the button while the stream resolves, an honest queue position in the toast and the progress card when other transfers are ahead, and haptic ticks on every download action (row buttons too).

MANDATORY
• This release is mandatory: installs below 30 lock with the full-screen update screen until 1.18.1 is installed. It installs over your current version with the same Team Nokiatis signature — your library, playlists and downloads stay exactly where they are.
